disambiguation: Not just a chat interface; it provides a full AI workspace with agents, tool use, and knowledge retrieval.
extras: Desktop only. Built-in move/delete tools are not included.
problem: Users need a way to interact with and analyze their entire knowledge base using advanced AI capabilities like agents and retrieval-augmented generation.
summary: An AI workspace that allows users to chat with their notes, explore their vault, and run multi-step tasks using Agents and retrieval-augmented generation.
